name: Benchmark for Sensitivity Analyses of Care Consumption and Costs
description: Provides reference estimates of uncertainty widths in care consumption and cost measures to be used as benchmarks in sensitivity analyses for economic evaluations.
reputation: A domain-specific reference used in health economics and medical informatics for benchmarking uncertainty in cost and care-consumption estimates, with targeted adoption by health-economics researchers.
notes: Not an ML/LLM benchmark; intended as a statistical reference for sensitivity analyses. Results may not generalize across health systems or datasets; users should consider contextual differences in costing and care-use patterns.
